en.name: e-Shram (National Database of Unorganised Workers)
en.description: National database and registration of unorganised sector workers to extend social security benefits.
en.eligibility: Unorganised workers aged 16-59, not members of EPFO/ESIC, with Aadhaar.
en.benefits: e-Shram card; eligibility for future social security/welfare schemes; portability.
application_steps: Visit eshram.gov.in; self-register with Aadhaar OTP.
Fill personal, occupation, and bank details.
faqs: How do I download my e-Shram card?
What is the official website for this service?
